design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Designed for an export business owner to process high volumes of trade data efficiently. Density and clarity are prioritized over decoration.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 rounded-sm
surface_styles.upload_zone: border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 hover:border-[#002FA7] hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] transition-colors duration-200 rounded-sm p-12 text-center

icons.style: duotone or regular, technical and precise

component_instructions.Buttons: Solid, sharp corners (rounded-sm). Primary button uses #002FA7. Must include hover states and focus rings. High contrast.
component_instructions.Data_Tables: Dense spacing (p-2 or p-3 cells). Sticky headers. Hover row highlights. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers.
component_instructions.Forms_Inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to have rounded-sm borders. Strict label typography (uppercase, tracked out).
component_instructions.Search_Bar: Prominent, large (h-12). Icon on the left. Must support immediate filtering feedback.
component_instructions.Modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Clean white background, 1px border, backdrop-blur-sm overlay.

image_urls.description: Cargo ship loaded with containers at a port. Perfect for the login screen background overlay. Apply a bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.
Textile factory imagery. Good for dummy product categories or empty states in the 'shirts'/'textiles' segment.
Complex white geometric shapes. Good for subtle background textures behind data cards or the upload zone.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA. Ensure all text on gray backgrounds is readable. Use #0F172A for primary text.
accessibility.focus_management: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, links, and table rows using kebab-case role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust dashboard layout with a collapsible sidebar and a sticky top header.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid pattern for the dashboard overview (tight gaps, dense data widgets).
Use Shadcn UI extensively for the tables, forms, and dialogs. Customize them to use 'rounded-sm' and strict border colors.
The search results page must feature a master-detail or highly segmented view. Group results by 'Country', 'Buyer', and 'Product'.
For the image upload component, create a prominent drag-and-drop zone using the 'upload_zone' surface style.
Ensure 'Chivo' is loaded for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Do NOT use arbitrary card shadows. Stick to the sharp, 1px border style defined in 'surface_styles'.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
